mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_sn, user_id, total_amount, pay_amount, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address) VALUES (#{orderSn}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress})
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, oi.item_id, oi.shoe_id, oi.product_sku, oi.product_name, oi.product_image, oi.product_price, oi.quantity, oi.total_price FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT o.*, oi.item_id, oi.shoe_id, oi.product_sku, oi.product_name, oi.product_image, oi.product_price, oi.quantity, oi.total_price FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_sn = #{orderSn}

SELECT order_id, order_sn, user_id, total_amount, pay_amount, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT order_id, order_sn, user_id, total_amount, pay_amount, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT order_id, order_sn, user_id, total_amount, pay_amount, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, created_at, updated_at FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET order_sn = #{orderSn}, user_id = #{userId}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, pay_amount = #{payAmount}, status = #{status}, receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, receiver_address = #{receiverAddress}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
